title.value: Answer tenant and rental prospect questions with AI

introduction.value: A commenter says AI tools handle most tenant questions, prospect inquiries and document preparation, handing harder cases to a human.

method.value: One commenter said they run two AI "employees" and named Lindy.AI when asked what they use. They said tenants text maintenance issues to the AI, which asks follow-up questions, creates work orders, and sends them to the maintenance crew; it also handles 90%+ of tenant questions, rental prospect inquiries, and document preparation, with one person still overseeing edge cases and checking outcomes.

outcome.value: They said the setup replaces the need to add more staff for the same workload and claimed the AI often handles angry tenants better than live staff. The clear limit they gave is that it still needs a person overseeing it for now.

notes.value: The main catch is ongoing human oversight: the commenter said one person still has to review how it handles cases so it stays on process.

source_text.body:
Answer tenant and rental prospect questions with AI
A commenter says AI tools handle most tenant questions, prospect inquiries and document preparation, handing harder cases to a human.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
One commenter said they run two AI "employees" and named Lindy.AI when asked what they use. They said tenants text maintenance issues to the AI, which asks follow-up questions, creates work orders, and sends them to the maintenance crew; it also handles 90%+ of tenant questions, rental prospect inquiries, and document preparation, with one person still overseeing edge cases and checking outcomes.
How it went
They said the setup replaces the need to add more staff for the same workload and claimed the AI often handles angry tenants better than live staff. The clear limit they gave is that it still needs a person overseeing it for now.
Worth knowing
The main catch is ongoing human oversight: the commenter said one person still has to review how it handles cases so it stays on process.
Try it yourself
with
Lindy
Copy prompt
Set up an assistant for my rental property at [address or portfolio]. It should answer common tenant and prospect questions using these details: [rent, pet policy, lease terms, application steps, maintenance process], and draft replies for me when a question falls outside them. Anything about legal issues, disputes or exceptions should be flagged to me instead of answered, and do not send any message until I have approved the first [number] drafts.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/PropertyManagement/comments/1wbct4o/ai_is_coming
